text:
tala: quick design ping attaching two micro-variants for the model catalog compare: 1) compact sticky-pin column + collapsed secondary badges, 2) roomy card-rows with full badges. link: https://imgur.com/mockup. looking for opinions on discoverability, keyboard flow, and pin copy. mike: sticky-pin column wins for quick scanning, especially when scrubbing many versions. collapsing secondary badges into a "+2" popover keeps the row tidy. only ask: does the popover content need to be action items or read-only info? esther: accessibility note: make the "+2" a button with `aria-expanded` and move focus into the popover when opened. popover should be a `role=dialog` with `aria-label="More metrics"` and Close on Esc. avoid hover-only reveals. joel: microcopy: hover title for pin should be "Pin version to compare" and SR text "Pin model v3.4 to compare (pinned to workspace)" when pinned. toast: "Pinned to workspace" for 1.8s. keep it lightweight. tala: about pin scope we discussed account vs workspace. engineering prefers workspace by default. i'll add a tiny org badge on the pin icon when it's workspace-scoped. any objections? mike: fine with workspace default. UX nit: when user pins multiple versions, show a removable chip in the filter bar like "Pinned (3)" so they understand the compare set changed. chip should be keyboard-removable. esther: yes, chip needs `aria-label="Remove pinned versions filter (3)"` and support Backspace/Delete. also ensure screen reader announces when pins are applied via an `aria-live=polite` region. joel: on badges: don't rely on color alone. add tiny glyphs (arrow/up/down or clock) and include textual abbreviations in collapsed view. legend in table header should be sticky and open a keyboard-focusable panel with thresholds (e.g., latency <120ms = green). tala: prototype included two focus styles: 2px solid brand or 3px thick halo. which is better for dense lists? mike: 3px halo is too heavy for compact mode; use 2px solid plus subtle shadow for larger targets. run contrast check on the outline vs tile/bg. esther: checklist from a11y: 1) roving tabindex for rows (one focus target per row), 2) pin toggle uses `aria-pressed`, 3) popover/legend use `role=dialog` + Esc close, 4) collapsed badges accessible, 5) color+icon for badge meaning, 6) aria-live for toasts. joel: small implementation snippet for the "+X" popover we can reuse: ```html
...
``` ensure `aria-expanded` toggles and focus goes into first focusable item inside the dialog. tala: great feedback. i'll update figma with sticky-pin + collapsed badges as primary, and include the a11y checklist and copy suggestions. will open a PR and tag @esther and @mike for final sign-off. react with :thumbsup: for sticky-pin variant, :eyes: for roomy-card variant. thanks! a11y-bot: Reminder: run keyboard-only, NVDA, and VoiceOver passes before merging.
